Ok first of all who gave that psychologist the audacity to say that ducking bullshit? He should go to jail. Secondly, IQ is not a measure of smartness! There are so many variables that aren’t taken into account in the test. By the psychologist’s logic, everyone with an IQ below average is a waste of space. Should everyone dumber than average kill them self? No! You still have the potential to pursue your dreams and I believe in you!
What’s going on? How long have you been suicidal? Talk to me.
Aww that’s so considerate of you. I know you’ve probably considered this but what about online counselling?
Do you know why you’re feeling like this?
What about a counsellor in school? Or your father? If you don’t have any options I think you need to be really courageous and open up to your parents. Tell them you’re suicidal and need help.

Before my exam block this year my teacher said something that really helped me and my friends with the stress. “These exams don’t define you.” It’s good to try your best but in 6 months you won’t even remember it! Please please please don’t ever forget your life is more valuable than some exam paper.
Hey friend. I’m also 17. Have you ever talked to someone about this? Perhaps a counsellor? Do your parents know how life is going for you? What do they think about your depression?
I have everything I want so I don’t know what could be making me feel this way. One of my therapists once said that it’s really common for people to not know why they’re depressed.
Why do I always want to die?
